tool.name: mumemto merge
tool.description: Merge multi-MUMs from multiple partitioned runs
tool.command:
## Symlink input .mums files to local names #set $mum_files_local = [] #for $i, $mum in enumerate($mum_files): #set $mum_name = 'input_' + str($i) + '.mums' ln -s '$mum' $mum_name && $mum_files_local.append($mum_name) #end for
mumemto merge #for $mum in $mum_files_local: '$mum' #end for -o 'merged.mums' && cp merged.mums '$merged_mums'

param.name: mum_files
param.label: Input .mums files
param.help: Two or more .mums files from separate mumemto find runs to merge

tool.help:
# Mumemto: Merge multi-MUMs
Mumemto merge combines multi-MUMs from multiple partitioned runs into a single `.mums` file. It auto-detects whether string-based or anchor-based merging should be used.
## Input
- Two or more `.mums` files from separate mumemto find runs.
## Limitations
Merging is currently limited to strict multi-MUMs.
## Output
- A merged `.mums` file containing the combined multi-MUMs.
For detailed usage, see the Mumemto wiki: https://github.com/vikshiv/mumemto/wiki
@ATTRIBUTION@
